name: Made New

provenance.detail: No named sermon playlist contains this message. It appears only in Watch Messages, so it stays Standalone Sunday.

description: Easter Sunday: Jesus lived, died, and rose, and with Paul in 1 Corinthians 15 Josh shows what the resurrection means for those made new in him.
note: An Easter message given between the Ezra and Ephesians series.

provenance.detail: The YouTube title is Made New.
